title: On 5 July 2026, Three Sons of Ayatollah Ali Khamenei Appeared at His Funeral Procession. Mojtaba — Identified in Pre-Funeral Analysis as the Leading Succession Candidate — Skipped. Iran Fears Israel Will Target Him If He Attends. PBS Reports the 'New Supreme Leader Remains in Hiding.' i24NEWS Reports Iran's Military Leadership Is Functionally Running the Country During the Funeral Week.
narrative: On 5 July 2026, i24NEWS reported that Mojtaba Khamenei, son of the late Ayatollah Ali Khamenei (killed in the 28 February 2026 US-Israeli strike on Tehran), wants to attend his father's burial but Iran fears Israel could target him at the ceremony. The Times of India headlined 'Successor in hiding? Three of Ali Khamenei's sons attend funeral, Mojtaba skips.' PBS NewsHour reported 'Khamenei's other sons appear at his funeral in Iran as new supreme leader remains in hiding.' A separate i24NEWS dispatch cited reporting that 'with new supreme leader wounded, Iran's military leadership is ruling Iran.' The state funeral is a six-day, two-country procession that began on 3 July in Tehran and runs to Mashhad, with Reuters describing 'mass grief' and 'Death to America' chants and AP/NPR framing it as Iran's first multi-day state funeral in decades. Fox News quoted an expert calling the funeral 'Khamenei's target-rich' event and 'Iran's biggest security gamble,' citing the mass gathering as a deliberate signal to the United States. Iran International reported live that 'Islamic Republic supporters chant kill Trump at Khamenei funeral.' No state media outlet in Iran has named Mojtaba's location, confirmed or denied his attendance, or identified who is functionally running the country's day-to-day decisions during the funeral week. The three sons who appeared have been identified in photo-agency coverage but no Iranian government source has commented on the asymmetry of Mojtaba's absence.
analysis:
The load-bearing finding is the three-sons-attended / Mojtaba-skipped asymmetry combined with the i24NEWS Iran-fears-strike formulation, the PBS 'successor remains in hiding' formulation, and the i24NEWS follow-on 'Iran's military leadership is ruling Iran' formulation — five distinct evidence layers in a single day's reporting.

1. The three-sons-attended / Mojtaba-skipped asymmetry is itself a primary-source data point. Photo agencies and stringers documented the procession attendance across the 3-5 July window. Three sons of Ali Khamenei appeared. Mojtaba — the candidate widely identified in pre-funeral analysis as a leading successor — did not. The skipped-attendance is being preserved on the public record without a single named Iranian source confirming a reason; the asymmetry is reported, the cause is not.

2. Iran-side fear-of-strike is on the record via i24NEWS. i24NEWS cited unnamed Iranian sources stating that the regime is keeping Mojtaba away from the procession out of fear Israel will target him. The fear is on the record. The mechanism is consistent with Israel's documented willingness to target Iranian leadership: the 28 February strike that killed Ali Khamenei is the prior data point. No Israeli source has confirmed or denied any specific operation against Mojtaba.

3. PBS's 'new supreme leader remains in hiding' formulation places the succession question in an unresolved-but-active state. PBS's formulation is the first English-language mainstream broadcast carrier to use this phrasing on the succession. The prior 4 July siphoned-truth article on the Khamenei funeral covered the procession itself and a formal bar on Mojtaba attending; this brief layers the PBS 'successor remains in hiding' formulation on the same calendar day.

4. The i24NEWS 'Iran's military leadership is ruling Iran' formulation is the second i24NEWS dispatch in the same 5 July window. The phrasing — 'with new supreme leader wounded, Iran's military leadership is ruling Iran' — is a structural finding. There is no named successor, the military is named as running the country during the funeral week, and the multi-day mass gathering is explicitly framed as a target-rich security event.

5. The Fox News 'target-rich' expert framing on the record. Fox cited an unnamed expert calling the funeral 'Khamenei's target-rich' event and 'Iran's biggest security gamble.' The mass gathering is being characterized as a deliberate signal to the United States. The mass gathering is also the day on which Iran's Hormuz 'service fees' rejection is being re-iterated and on which chants against Trump have been documented by Iran International.

6. The day's evidence cluster is unusually dense. A target-rich mass gathering during a known succession vacuum, with chants against the US president, on the same calendar day as Iran's Hormuz 'service fees' rejection (rejected by Trump but re-iterated by Iran via the Jerusalem Post on the same day in the same window) and on the same calendar day as five-voice US/Iran Hormuz contradiction stack — the day's evidence cluster is dense on the regime-succession and regime-maritime-control questions simultaneously.
verdict: [SIPHONED VERDICT]: On 5 July 2026, photo agencies and stringers documented three sons of Ayatollah Ali Khamenei appearing at his state-funeral procession; Mojtaba Khamenei — identified in pre-funeral analysis as a leading succession candidate — did not; i24NEWS cited unnamed Iranian sources stating the regime is keeping Mojtaba away out of fear Israel will target him at the ceremony; PBS NewsHour reported 'new supreme leader remains in hiding'; a second i24NEWS dispatch reported 'with new supreme leader wounded, Iran's military leadership is ruling Iran'; Fox News cited an expert calling the funeral 'target-rich' and 'Iran's biggest security gamble'; Iran International reported chants of 'kill Trump' at the funeral; no Iranian state media outlet has named Mojtaba's location, confirmed or denied his attendance, or identified who is functionally running the country during the six-day funeral window. The structural finding is a succession vacuum in public, with a three-sons-attended / Mojtaba-skipped attendance asymmetry documented in public, with the regime's fear-of-strike framing on the record, with the successor's 'in hiding' framing on the record, with the military's 'ruling Iran' framing on the record — and with no Iranian government statement identifying who is functionally in charge during the window. Beat-distinct from the 4 July khamenei-funeral-six-day-mourning-trump-week-off piece — that article covered the procession itself, the formal bar on Mojtaba attending, and the resistance-front-coalition framing; this brief layers the 5 July three-sons-vs-Mojtaba attendance asymmetry, the i24NEWS Iran-fears-strike report, the PBS 'successor in hiding' formulation, the i24NEWS military-ruling-Iran follow-on, the Fox 'target-rich' expert framing, and the structural succession vacuum as the load-bearing finding.
